reserveReview.rationale: The August 2026 agreed-upon-procedures report presents the complete reserve account at 12:02 PM Western Indonesian Time on August 28. It reports Rp4,005,850,153 of ORI030, Rp5,999,326,639 at PT Bank Ina Perdana, Rp12,800,105 at PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia, Rp1,397,250,014 at Indodax, Rp877,402,547 at Duitku, and Rp1,000,284,179 at PINTU. The six balances total Rp13,292,913,637 against Rp13,253,263,412 of IDRX in circulation, a Rp39,650,225 surplus. Percentages use the reserve total as denominator and sum to 100% after rounding. The report compares the bank, exchange, wallet, and ORI030 evidence with the reserve account, but explicitly remains an agreed-upon-procedures engagement rather than an audit or assurance opinion.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KAP Jojo Sunarjo & Rekan agreed-upon-procedures Reserve Account Report as of 2026-08-28, using the six institution or instrument balances in its complete reserve table
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report identifies all six reserve rows and includes supporting evidence for Bank Ina, BRI, Indodax, Duitku, PINTU, and the ORI030 secondary account. It does not provide an assurance opinion, establish account segregation or bankruptcy remoteness, disclose rehypothecation limits, or identify the underlying depository institution for the ORI030 account confirmed by GHP Consulting.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The report identifies ORI030 and five institution-level balances, while GHP Consulting's statement confirms the ORI030 secondary account. The materials do not identify the underlying ORI030 depository or custodian, establish legal account segregation or bankruptcy remoteness, disclose rehypothecation terms, provide bond maturity detail, or state a redemption settlement time.
